title: Fixed Deep-Blind-Sleeve Twin-Grip Post Driver
description: One newly authored complete static twin-grip post-driver appearance, displayed horizontally so the actual deep empty working sleeve is visible. One continuous thick cylindrical wall ends in a genuinely solid thick closed rear head; the opposite end is a full open annular mouth with an actual long blind inner cavity. Two full elongated round-corner loop handles extend symmetrically along the opposite sides and join the tube at their real end straps. All wall, cap thickness, handle material and handle holes are actual closed finite geometry, not decals or a reused can with additional grips. Unlike the paired broad open shovel jaws/long timber handles of the post-hole digger and the bilged side-hatch crank barrel on its stand, this is a compact heavy-ended blind sleeve with two long side loops; no old visible geometry imported. One model zero scenes, blunt static art only. No post included, impact, weight, strength, motion, driving performance, ergonomics, fabrication or safety validation.
